reason: Clipping a canonical band triangle creates non-unit affine interpolated vectors. Storing each clipped vertex as a custom normal normalizes it before the next interpolation and can change the rendered field. Preserve the exact original affine interpolation, then normalize at shading, rather than impose one storage method.

normalContract.required: Actual post-interpolation normalized normal used by the native shader must equal the canonical middle rendered normal field through both .025 collars, with the correct W identity/N Rz90 and all4 root transforms. Preserve its true longitudinal variation.
normalContract.allowedImplementation: Native geometry/custom normals, packed normal transfer, or an equivalent native CORNER vector attribute/shader normal path. Literal packed custom-normal bytes and literal node-graph identity are not universal gates when the final evaluated rendered field is equivalent.
normalContract.separateEvidence: Record geometric custom-normal field and native encoding drift separately; do not report raw attribute vectors or geometric normals as the final shader normal. Retain clipping/re-encoding failures and unchanged canonical controls.
normalContract.verification: Bind actual source attribute values/triangles/interpolation and shader graph/transforms, sample rendered normal/albedo controls across both complete collars and all4 rotations, plus actual native and independent current-consumer join images. Mathematical field equivalence and visible continuity are both required.
notWaived: Exact finite port/collar geometry and actual finite support/envelope
Canonical point albedo/material lighting behavior and cap bump/coordinate behavior
No local visible seam/crack/line/band/step/opaque-interior alpha loss
No RGB/alpha repair/overlap/per-view fit/runtime helper changes

unchanged: Fixed target, independent visible criteria, actual geometry/profile/finite ground/envelope, short collars, camera/registration/sampling/lights, animation and all4 visual evidence requirements remain unchanged. This reconciles an implementation-specific storage restriction; it grants no candidate approval or numerical-only seam waiver.
